# Fixtures

Captures of real responses, trimmed to a few hundred kilobytes at most and never edited by hand
beyond removing rows. Each folder documents, for each capture, when it was taken, from where
(without keys) and how it was trimmed.

A provider whose terms allow no copy kept or handed on is not captured: its answers are written by
hand in its documented shape, with invented names, identifiers and texts, and marked "written for
the tests" in the folder's README with the clause that rules it out. They are the AeroDataBox
answers (`on-demand/`), the Ticketmaster page and the Live Nation venue pages (`events/`), the PNCT
schedule page (`harbor/`), the PATH alerts (`regional/`) and the adsb.fi answer (`air/`).

| Folder           | Provider family                                                                            |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `mta/`           | Metropolitan Transportation Authority                                                      |
| `city/`          | FAA, NYC DOT and the National Weather Service                                              |
| `ny511/`         | 511NY map layers                                                                           |
| `street/`        | NYC Open Data, data.ny.gov and AFDC (street, parking, chargers, defibrillators, restrooms) |
| `on-demand/`     | Transitous, NYC GeoSearch and AeroDataBox                                                  |
| `journey/`       | One trip, plan and live subway feed taken at once                                          |
| `openai/`        | OpenAI Responses API, official reference examples                                          |
| `regional/`      | MTA LIRR and Metro-North, Port Authority PATH                                              |
| `ferries/`       | NYC Ferry and NYC DOT (Staten Island Ferry)                                                |
| `harbor/`        | US Coast Guard, PNCT and NOAA PORTS                                                        |
| `bikes/`         | Citi Bike GBFS                                                                             |
| `air/`           | adsb.lol and adsb.fi (ADS-B)                                                               |
| `sea/`           | Open Waters (AIS)                                                                          |
| `amtrak/`        | Amtraker (Amtrak trains)                                                                   |
| `westchester/`   | Westchester County Bee-Line                                                                |
| `shuttles/`      | Passio (airport and university shuttles)                                                   |
| `micromobility/` | Lime, Veo and Bird GBFS                                                                    |
| `city-ops/`      | PlowNYC                                                                                    |
| `paypal/`        | PayPal REST API, official reference examples                                               |
